code.help: Whoever installed ReportAI saw it in the terminal when the installation finished. If you don't have it, ask them to run on the server:
code.label: Code

company.title: Your company
company.name: Company name
company.languageHint: The one the bot speaks with your team

admin.title: Your administrator account
admin.help: You'll sign in to the panel with it and invite the rest of the team.
admin.name: Your name

ai.title: The AI that reads the messages
ai.help: ReportAI uses your own account with the AI provider: each report's cost (a few cents) goes straight to your account. The key is stored encrypted.
ai.modelHint: The model's name as the provider gives it

voice.title: Voice notes
voice.help: A service that turns audio into text. Groq is fast and very cheap.

email.title: Outgoing email
email.help: To email reports, invitations and password resets. You can leave it for later.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.step1: In Telegram, open {'@'}BotFather and send it /newbot.
telegram.step2: Pick a name and a username for the bot (e.g. GarciaReportsBot).
telegram.step3: Copy the token it gives you and paste it here.
telegram.later: You can skip this step and add the channel later under Channels. Then you'll invite your team with a link.
telegram.rejected: Telegram doesn't accept that token. Copy it again from {'@'}BotFather, whole.
